recipes.title: Build a Claude Agent SDK Release Assistant with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A Claude Agent SDK agent whose in-process tools are checked by ArmorIQ in canUseTool, so reads run, deploys wait for approval, and deletes are blocked.

recipes.title: Build a CrewAI Crew with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A two agent CrewAI crew (a crypto researcher and a writer) wrapped with ArmorIQCrew, with an honest look at its proxy only limits compared with the other framework adapters.

recipes.title: Build a Delegating CrewAI Crew with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A two agent CrewAI incident crew where the lead hands its log analyst a narrower delegated token, so the analyst reads metrics and logs but is refused the restart the lead then makes.

recipes.title: Build a Google ADK Agent with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: An internal ops copilot on Google's Agent Development Kit that refunds a charge, holds a larger credit for human approval, and blocks a prompt injected data export.

recipes.title: Build a governed SQL analyst with LangChain and the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A LangChain data analyst over a local SQLite MCP server where selects run, inserts and updates wait for approval, and drops, deletes, exports, and a planted injection row are stopped.

recipes.title: Build a LangChain Agent with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A LangChain tool calling weather agent governed by the shipped ArmorIQLangChain callback handler, with every tool call the model picks checked against policy.

recipes.title: Build a LangGraph approval interrupt with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: An on-call LangGraph agent where status and log reads run, an ArmorIQ hold on a restart becomes a native interrupt() resumed through the checkpointer, and deleting a volume is blocked.

recipes.title: Govern an OpenAI Agents SDK Agent with Intent Gateway
recipes.summary: An accounts payable agent on the OpenAI Agents SDK goes from record only, to Monitor mode, to enforced policy by changing nothing but its base URL.

recipes.title: Build a Release Agent That Handles Blocks with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A framework free plan, intent token, and invoke loop in Python that deploys builds, waits on a held production deploy, and recovers from blocks, expired tokens, and off plan steps.

recipes.title: Build a Cross-MCP Research Agent with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: One signed plan that reads a file on the filesystem MCP server and stores the summary on the memory MCP server, each step checked by its own server policy.

recipes.title: Build a Crypto Prices Agent with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A crypto prices assistant planned by Gemini, backed by a self built CoinGecko MCP server, with every tool call checked against an ArmorIQ policy.

recipes.title: Build a Filesystem Notes Agent with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A notes assistant on the filesystem MCP server where reads are allowed and every write is held for human approval.

recipes.title: Build a GitHub Agent with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A CLI agent that searches, reads, and explores a GitHub repository through the GitHub MCP server, with every tool call checked against policy.

recipes.title: Build a GitHub Write Guard with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A GitHub agent where reads run freely, pull requests and file edits wait for human approval, and repository deletion is blocked.

recipes.title: Build a Memory Knowledge Agent with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A knowledge graph assistant on the memory MCP server where reads are allowed, new facts are held, and memory wipes are blocked.

recipes.title: Build a Postgres Agent with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A CLI agent that turns plain English into SQL for a Postgres MCP server, with every query held for a human to read before it runs.

recipes.title: Build a Strands Agent with the ArmorIQ SDK
recipes.summary: A support-desk assistant on AWS Strands Agents where reads and replies are allowed, refunds wait for human approval, closing an account is blocked, and a planted prompt injection ticket goes nowhere.

recipes.title: Govern a Vercel AI SDK Support Bot with Intent Gateway
recipes.summary: A Claude support bot on the Vercel AI SDK whose lookups pass, whose credit and account deletion are stopped by Intent Gateway, and who explains why.
